svg.aria-label: Stack por capas. Interfaz: TypeScript, React Native + Expo, React, Angular, C# / .NET + SQL Server. API: Node.js + NestJS, Express, Java + Spring Boot, API REST + JWT, Stripe. Datos: PostgreSQL, MySQL / MariaDB, MongoDB, Odoo + Python. Despliegue: Docker, GitHub Actions y Azure, Testing (Jest, MSTest).
